minecraft:written_book_content.title: A Passage to Paradis
minecraft:written_book_content.author: Paradis Relief Council
pages:
{"text":"A CALL FROM PARADIS

The city swore an oath of peace. Its soldiers laid down their blades.

The Titans made no such promise.
Now the bells ring for strangers willing to defend those who will not fight."}

{"text":"THE SILENT ARMORIES

The old regiments left supplies scattered through the city.

Search the buildings, salvage what you can, and forge what is missing.
Take up their blades. Become a soldier for Paradis."}

{"text":"THE CROSSING

Find the Overworld dock:
X: -713
Z: -180
Deck: Y 64
Walk south to its portal.
In Paradis, a return portal leads home. Mark one before wandering far."}

{"text":"READ BEFORE FLIGHT

These are DEFAULT keys.

Options > Controls > Key Binds shows your bindings and conflicts.
Search Danny's AOT.
H is used for both a hook and the cloak hood: rebind one."}

{"text":"ODM: GET EQUIPPED

Wear ODM gear in the leggings slot.

Hold a blade grip in BOTH hands. F swaps the selected item to your offhand.

Carry spare blades and a filled gas canister."}

{"text":"ODM: TAKE FLIGHT

Aim at terrain.
Hold G: left hook.
Hold H: right hook.
Release a key: detach.

Hold Space to boost.
A/D orbit while hooked.
Practice low over open ground before fighting."}

{"text":"BLADES & BOOTS

Attack with your blades; aim for a Titan's nape.

R ejects a fitted blade or loads a spare blade component into an empty grip.

ODM boots reduce fall damage, not all of it!"}

{"text":"GAS CANISTER

Keep iceburst clusters in your inventory.

Right-click the canister to fill it.
Sneak + right-click to fuel your worn ODM gear.
If realistic resource use is enabled, use the furnace to refill."}

{"text":"APG EQUIPMENT
Wear APG ODM gear and hold APG guns in both hands.
R loads/unloads cartridges.
Hold right-click to aim; left-click to fire.
Hooks: G/H. Boost: Space.
Carry spare cartridges!"}

{"text":"APG HOOK WARNING

A single attached hook occupies that hand's gun.

Release that hook to aim the gun, or attach both hooks.
Aim without sneaking.
APG gear needs gas just like blade ODM gear."}

{"text":"THUNDER SPEARS

Hold blade grips and carry spears.

V loads or unloads a spear on a grip.
Sneak + left-click fires the left spear; sneak + right-click fires the right.
Keep clear of the explosion!"}

{"text":"FLARE GUN

Carry flare cartridges.
X loads a cartridge.
C switches cartridge type.
Right-click fires.
Use signals to regroup with your friends before a rescue becomes another casualty."}

{"text":"UNIFORMS & CLOAKS

Equip armor in its matching slot; it needs no activation key.

H toggles a worn cloak's hood. A raised hood reduces Titan targeting range.
Resolve the H hook conflict first!"}

{"text":"THE QUARTERMASTER

Ingots, wires, springs, cylinders and leather are crafting parts, not abilities.

Use JEI for recipes: hover an item and press R; U shows uses.
Carry food, spare blades, gas and ammunition."}

{"text":"FORGING STEEL

Use the Iceburst Furnace:
Iron bamboo + raw iron makes hardened iron bamboo.
Hardened iron bamboo + iron ingot makes ultrahard steel.
Supply fuel. Use JEI for the equipment recipes."}

{"text":"PARADIS RESOURCES

Iron bamboo grows in the Giant Forest.

Search deep caves below Y 0 for iceburst; its ore generation centers span Y -64 to -1.
Paradis also generates ordinary ores, including iron."}

{"text":"SUPPLY LINES

Do not assume the city supplies everything.

Recipes also use leather, wool, dyes and other vanilla goods.
Bring supplies from home. Overworld cactus is a useful source of green dye."}

{"text":"SHIFTER FIELD NOTES

B shifts only if you have earned a compatible Titan power.
1-9 select shifter abilities; Z roars. Abilities vary by Titan.
On DrewCraft, Titan transformations belong in Paradis, not home."}

{"text":"OTHER FIELD ITEMS

Armor Potion: hardening for eligible shifters only.

Handcuffs: hold right-click on a target for 5 seconds; the key releases them.

Basement Key is marked WIP upstream."}

{"text":"YOUR ORDERS

Protect the civilians.
Recover useful supplies.
Learn the rooftops.
Never leave a friend behind.
Their oath is peace.
Your choice is whether peace survives.
-- Paradis Relief Council"}
